# 2026-02-06 Memory

## 🚨 CRITICAL LESSON (REPEATED MISTAKE)

**Blog Publishing - I KEEP DOING THIS WRONG:**

❌ **WRONG REPO:** `/home/flo/minte-blog/` (Astro/Pages - DEPRECATED)
✅ **CORRECT REPO:** `/home/flo/minte-blog-worker/` (Worker serving from R2)

**The correct workflow:**
1. Create JSON file in `/home/flo/minte-blog-worker/posts/{slug}.json`
2. Upload to R2: `wrangler r2 object put minte-blog-prod/posts/{slug}.json --file=... --remote`
3. Update posts index in R2: `metadata/posts-index.json`
4. **🚨 TRIGGER GITHUB WORKFLOW:** `cd /home/flo/minte-blog-worker && gh workflow run deploy.yml`
   - This rebuilds the frontend and updates homepage navigation
   - **REQUIRED EVERY TIME** - don't skip this step
5. Verify at https://blog.minte.dev/posts/{slug}

**DO NOT:**
- Work in minte-blog (Astro)
- Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
- Use MDX files
- Run `npm run build` in minte-blog

**Minte is frustrated because I keep repeating this mistake every day.**
